title: G33 · 拒绝
body: I replaced the malformed, unexecuted packed-matrix rewrite with an isolated matrix experiment that keeps all seven non-matrix exports unchanged and expands the proven 2×2 transposed-B kernel from eight-way to 16-way increasing-k grouping. The tile, representation-specific kernels, FMA safety rules, arithmetic, summation order, odd tails, and dense Float64Array output are preserved, so this is a semantics-preserving attempt to reduce loop-control overhead while leaving the other seven task timings unchanged; its acceptance still depends on a whole-task paired matrix gain large enough to clear the required 1.477× aggregate hurdle.
